text: Sign up ke baad poocha jata hai ki aapka card kis kaam ke liye hai. Agar aap Shubhora partner hain, to form bharne ki zaroorat nahi. Bas Make my Shubhora card dabaiye.
Aur agar apni dukaan ya business ka card banana hai, to My own business or work chuniye, aur Continue dabaiye.
Ab apna pehla product daliye. Camera ya gallery se photo lagaiye, product ka naam likhiye, MRP aur offer price daliye, aur Save dabaiye.
Ab AI aapka card taiyaar kar raha hai. Bas aadha minute se ek minute lagta hai.
Products MRP aur offer price ke saath dikhte hain, aur Order on WhatsApp se order seedha aapke paas aata hai.
To der kis baat ki? Aaj hi apna free V-Card banaiye. Zyada jaankari ke liye hamari website dekhiye, shubhora dot com.
